steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree and completion of project management education hours—no prior work experience needed. Verify your education background meets PMI standards before enrolling.

steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp course. steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing your education, apply directly to PMI and pay the exam fee. PMI reviews your eligibility and credentials application. Allow adequate time for processing before your planned exam date. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application process and required documentation.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation support to review CAPM domains, test strategies, and sample questions. Your instructor-led training covers the full exam scope. Schedule your exam through PMI's testing partner when you feel ready, and sit for the computer-based assessment.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn professional development units (PDUs) across a three-year renewal cycle to keep your credential active. Pursue relevant training, volunteer work, or professional activities that advance your project management skills. Renew on schedule to sustain your competitive edge in Toledo's job market.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.
